issues: ReceiptCaptureScreen navigation delay: In `expo-app/src/screens/ReceiptCaptureScreen.tsx` (line ~68), the code uses `setTimeout(() => navigation.navigate('Dashboard', { receiptSaved: true }), 1500);` which delays navigation after a receipt is saved. The "no delayed navigation" static check fails and the UI flow test expects an immediate navigation with a toast on the Dashboard. Fix by navigating immediately (`navigation.navigate('Dashboard', { receiptSaved: true })`) and rely on the Dashboard to display the success message.

MileageEntryScreen behavior mismatch: In `expo-app/src/screens/MileageEntryScreen.tsx` (original code), after saving a mileage entry the code calls `navigation.navigate('Dashboard');`, navigating away from the mileage screen. The design spec and UI flow test require staying on the Mileage screen, showing a toast "Mileage entry saved." and displaying the new entry in a list (so the test can find the entered "120" value). Update the component to (a) set a success message on the same screen, (b) fetch and render the list of mileage entries (e.g., using a FlatList), and (c) remove the navigation away.
feedback: Both the receipt capture and mileage entry screens have UI flow issues that cause the automated UI tests to fail. Adjust the navigation logic and add the required mileage list display as described.
